works.title: The Line Artist Allowlist
works.statement:
The Line Artist Allowlist (TLAA) is for artists on The Line to allowlist their artists frens on The Line.

Mint The Line Artist Allowlist  
https://app.manifold.xyz/c/the-line-artist-allowlist

HOW TO USE  
1. Copy and paste The Line Artist Allowlist (TLAA) shown in the NFT.  
2. Save TLAA as a .csv file on your computer.  
3. Upload TLAA to Manifold Claim Page as to set allowlist for your next art mint.

For artists, by artists.

lfffline!!
